title: Zombie Enhanced
description: Zombies are now more dangerous, with special items — from a pickaxe that breaks blocks to an anvil that stuns players.
body:
# Zombie Enhanced

Minecraft Fabric mod — enhanced zombies with unique items, abilities, and configurable block-breaking.

## Features
🧟‍♂️ Zombies are now more dangerous than before. Some zombies spawn with special items that make them much harder in combat.  
Some zombies can also **break certain blocks**, configurable via `zombie_enhanced_config.json`.

| Zombie Type      | Item Held           | Effect                                                   |
| ---------------- | ------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------- |
| Fisher zombie    | 🎣 Fishing rod      | Pulls you towards them                                   |
| Sprinter zombie  | ⚡ Speed potion     | Runs faster when you're nearby                           |
| Medic zombie     | ❤️ Healing potion   | Heals itself when hurt                                   |
| Brawler zombie   | 💪 Strength potion  | Hits harder up close                                     |
| Ghost zombie     | 👻 Invisibility potion | Disappears from sight at range                         |
| Chieftain zombie | 💀 Skull banner (head) | Makes nearby zombies stronger and summons for help                        |
| Smasher zombie   | ⚒️ Anvil            | Hits hard + blinds + slows you                            |
| Miner zombie     | ⛏️ Pickaxe          | Breaks configurable blocks (`breakableBlocks` in config) |
| Axe zombie       | 🪓 Stone axe        | Just hits harder                                         |
| Bomber zombie    | 💣 TNT             | Explodes after a short timer                              |
| Shield zombie    | 🛡️ Shield + Sword  | Blocks attacks, shield has limited durability           
| Igniter Zombie    | 🔥 Torch  | Sets target on fire for 4 seconds when hitting          

## Configuration
- File: `zombie_enhanced_config.json` (created automatically in the `config` folder).  
- Configurable options:  
  - `breakableBlocks`: list of block IDs zombies can mine.  
  - `zombieItemSpawnChance`: chance a zombie spawns with a special item.  
  - `bannerRadius`: radius for Chieftain zombie buffs.  
  - `digSpeed`: mining speed for Miner zombies.
